bio.text: Bob Duff, a Democrat, has represented Connecticut Senate District 25 since 2005.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Lynchburg College in 1993.
His professional experience includes working as a substitute teacher for Norwalk Public Schools from 1993 to 1995 and as a realtor for William Pitt Sotheby's International Realty starting in 1995.
